verdict.rationale: Item catalogs and inventory are a fair question for a payments/POS provider like SumUp, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence documents an item catalog, inventory counts, or stock sync across registers and channels. The pricing-page mentions of "Multi-device sync" and multi-store back-office management never say what is synced, so they are adjacent claims and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can manage an item catalog with inventory counts that stay in sync across registers and channels
